Today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break deals are now ready to roll, and alongside this week’s AirPods Pro 3, AirPods 4, and AirPods Max 2 discounts still rolling with delivery before Mother’s Day, we are also tracking another chance to land the best deal ever on the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery at nearly 40% off the list price (could jump back up in price at any time). From there we move on to a particularly notable deal on this 24GB 15-inch M5 MacBook Air at $220 off (this is the more affordable 512GB model this time) as well as Apple’s most accessible M5 Pro MacBook Pro sitting at all-time low pricing today with $250 off the list. These deals join loads of official Apple accessories on sale this week from $6 – AirTag, cables, Magic Mouse, and more – as well as the most affordable 2026 Apple Studio Display back at Amazon low pricing (now $100 off). Everything else awaits below.

This week’s AirPods 4, Pro 3, and Max 2 deals are still shipping in time for Mother’s Day

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods Max 2 $510 (Reg. $549) – Amazon all-time low

Now live again: Official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery just dropped back to all-time low at nearly 40% off

Amazon has just dropped the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery back down to its best price to date. We saw this deal come and go very quickly a couple days ago, but it is now back.

Regularly $99, Amazon is now once again offering the Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery down at $59.99 shipped. If this offer is anything like last go around, it might not be around for very long.

There are smaller and more affordable MagSafe power banks out there, but I would argue that many of the most elegant options are close to the deal price we have here today anyway – like this Anker Nano Power Bank at $55. Some of the third-party options do, however, carry more battery capacity and there are some color options when looking outside of the Apple lineup, but I still think the official model is the most elegant option. It is one of the thinnest out there, delivers up to 65% additional charge, features iOS Battery Widget support, and fits along the back of iPhone Air perfectly.

This 24GB 15-inch M5 MacBook Air is $220 off at $1,299 ($400 under the model Amazon sells)

Amazon is still offering the base and most affordable new M5 MacBook Air at the best price with $150 in savings on all four colors. But those looking towards the 15-inch models, B&H has some particularly compelling offers this week that are set to end in a couple day’s time, and we just spotted another config at $220 off the list price.

B&H is now offering the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB of RAM and the 512GB internal SSD down at $1,299 shipped.

This is a regularly $1,499 machine, but B&H is also shipping it with the “upgraded” 35W Dual USB-C Port Compact Power Adapter, instead of the single 40W model that comes standard.

Configuring this same machine at Apple with the 35W Dual USB-C Port Compact Power Adapter will raise the spend to $1,519 – this leaves today’s B&H deal at $220 off the list price.

It is also worth noting that the only 24GB 15-inch M5 MacBook Air Amazon sells is the 1TB model, so you won’t find a 24GB anywhere near this low there:

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/512GB $1,299 (Reg. $1,519) | B&H
    • With 35W Dual USB-C Port Compact Power Adapter ($20 value)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,549 (Reg. $1,699) | Amazon
    • With standard 40W single port charger

While we are clearly talking about a machine with half the storage, this is very much a notable chance to score a 24GB model for much less. And whether or not the 35W dual port is actually an upgrade in your eyes, we are still landing a 24GB machine for $250 less.

There are also a couple other special B&H M5 Air bundles to keep in mind for the 1TB config as well:

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,499 (Reg. $1,719)
    • With 70W USB-C Power Adapter upgrade included ($20 value)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,499 (Reg. $1,719)
    • With 35W Dual USB-C Port Compact Power Adapter upgrade included ($20 value)

Amazon M5 MacBook Air deals:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $949 (Reg. $1,099)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,149 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,349 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,149 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,349 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,549 (Reg. $1,699)

Apple’s most accessible M5 Pro MacBook Pro sitting at all-time low pricing today ($250 off)

The authorized Apple dealers at B&H are landing this week with some particularly compelling deals on the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air at up to $220 off. And while Amazon is undercutting B&H on much of the new 2026 M5 Pro MacBook Pro models now, it still hasn’t beat out the straight $250 discount on the most affordable 14-inch M5 Pro machine you can buy.

As of right now, Amazon is charging just shy of $1,984 for the base 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and the 1TB internal SSD.

However, over at B&H this same machine in Space Black will drop down to $1,949 in the cart. Regularly $2,199, that’s a straight up $250 price drop on the most accessible M5 Pro MacBook Pro Apple makes.

Apple’s new AirPods Max 2 hit a new Amazon all-time low price (Now on all colors)

Update 5/4: All of the AirPods Max 2 colors have now hit new Amazon all-time lows starting at $509 shipped.

It’s not a giant price drop or anything, but if you are looking to land a brand new set of Apple’s next-generation AirPods Max 2 the Midnight and Starlight models have now hit a new Amazon all-time low.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s AirPods Max 2 down at $509.99 shipped. This deal is only live on the Midnight and Starlight colorways, but we are talking about a new Amazon all-time low and the best price we have tracked in brand new condition since release.

Loads of official Apple accessories on sale this week from $6: AirTag, AirPods, cables, Magic Mouse, more
